description.value: A whole-brain study dissociating neural correlates of memory disorders in early Alzheimer’s disease and frontotemporal lobar degeneration using FDG-PET hypometabolism and MRI voxel-based morphometry.

value: General lesion patterns as revealed by hypometabolism and atrophy should differ between the two syndromes, with a parietotemporal distribution in AD and frontotemporal in FTLD.

description.value: MRI and FDG-PET images were co-registered and interpolated to 1×1×1 mm resolution; FDG-PET images underwent partial-volume-effect correction, MRI data underwent bias correction, both modalities were spatially normalized to a study-specific DARTEL template, MRI data were modulated, non-gray-matter voxels were masked, and images were smoothed with a 12 mm FWHM kernel. FDG-PET intensities were normalized to cerebellar values. Processing used SPM5 with Matlab 7.7.

[62] ), modulation of MRI data, masking of non gray matter voxels and smoothing using a 12 mm FWHM kernel.
